title: Event envelope
description: Every analytics event. Flat and typed on purpose: a catch-all blob is unqueryable the moment a warehouse exists, and it forces the no-content check to read inside an opaque field.

occurred_at.description: Device clock. May be wrong and may be late.

subject_id.description: The per-account pseudonym, never a real account id. Erasure destroys the mapping, after which every event already written is permanently unattributable.

session_id.description: Null is meaningful: background work has no foreground session and must not inflate engagement.

properties.description: Structured references only. Never a title, a transcript, an address or a URL a person dumped (OFF-1).
